THE DECISION FLOW

A way of seeing. A way of working.
01 / REALITY

Complex problems rarely arrive structured.

Start with the world as it is: fragmented information, competing priorities, real constraints.

02 / SIGNAL

I find the signal.

Separate what matters from what merely adds noise.

03 / EVIDENCE

Build the evidence.

Turn observations into a defensible analytical foundation.

04 / DECISION

Frame the decision.

Make the alternatives, assumptions and trade-offs explicit.

05 / SYSTEM

And design systems that can act on it.

Connect policy, people, capital, technology, institutions and implementation.

06 / ARRIVAL

Economics × Policy × Evidence × Technology.

One connected practice, from the first question to a workable system.
